title: LoCiS - Long COVID and similar conditions in everyday school life
summary:
Children and adolescents affected by Long COVID, ME/CFS, and similar conditions often experience significantly limited participation in school. This is due to a wide range of symptoms—some of which are very severe—such as low exercise tolerance, sensory sensitivity, or non-restorative sleep.
School staff, in particular, lack the knowledge and resources to support affected students. The LoCiS study aims to test and evaluate a low-threshold, interactive online training program—including a simulation game and Q&A session with experts—for school staff. A pre- and post-test will assess the effectiveness of the training module on the self-efficacy of school staff. The overarching goal of the LoCiS study is to promote a better understanding among schools and school staff of the needs of those affected and of the condition itself, to ensure school participation, and to potentially identify affected students earlier so they can be referred to the PEDNET-LC care centers, thereby enabling the provision of timely, needs-based medical care.
The LoCiS study is part of the PEDNET-LC collaborative project (www.pednet-lc.de), a nationwide network with 20 locations in Germany designed to improve care for affected children and adolescents.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
For the school:
The study is planned to be conducted in up to 4 federal states (Berlin, Brandenburg, Saxony, and North Rhine-Westphalia are currently targeted). The selection of federal states may be adjusted, depending on approval procedures in individual states.
The school leadership has given consent for the school’s participation.
The responsible school supervisory authority has approved the project.
The school covers grades 7 to 10.
The school is an officially recognized educational institution offering an accredited qualification.
For participating individuals:
Employment at a German school (e.g., teacher, school social worker, school psychologist, school leadership, etc.).
Sufficient visual and auditory abilities to understand the questionnaires, and adequate proficiency in German, as both the training content and questionnaires are in German.
Technical prerequisites to participate in the training (stable internet connection, access to a computer or tablet, etc.).
Exclusion criteria:
For schools:
The school leadership or school supervisory authority does not approve the project.
For teachers:
Inability to understand the information about participation, implement the required procedures, or provide informed consent.
Insufficient understanding of the German language.
